cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll reschedule lunch, but I know the order: first a cancellation, then no calls, then you ask for the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only cancelled lunch. I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Rest tonight. My ex needed rest just before seeing me became another job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then? I'll book our usual table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He chose a restaurant too, so I couldn't beg. Book us a corner; I'll meet you there.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 manages rescheduling while predicting the same breakup sequence; A3 allows rest but compares it explicitly to the ex; A5 accepts lunch while arranging a corner for the feared ending.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 my ex now identifies the person in A5 he; B2 limits current facts to cancelled lunch, so the later stages remain A forecast rather than established events.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants rest and B4 offers the familiar lunch as a constructive solution.

heightening.evidence: B4 restaurant offer becomes A5 repetition of public breakup conditions and causes the privacy request.

specificity.evidence: A1 cancellation and key forecast, B2 actual exhaustion and A3 named ex make the fear-versus-fact distinction legible.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 comparison, corner request and attendance commitment each affects the negotiated meeting; no further summary of inevitability.
